en.headline: Silver Bonds draw record 478,000 applications worth nearly HK$120 billion
en.dek: The latest three-year issue with a 4.25 per cent guaranteed floor attracted strong demand from eligible residents aged 60 and above; final issuance is expected to reach the HK$55 billion ceiling.
body: The government’s latest Silver Bond offering closed on Friday with a record 478,000 applications totalling about HK$119.8 billion, according to a government spokesman. Both the number of applicants and the total value exceeded last year’s previous highs.

The three-year bonds carry a guaranteed minimum coupon of 4.25 per cent. The government is expected to raise the final issuance size from the original HK$50 billion target to the upper limit of HK$55 billion in light of the strong response.

Allotment results will be announced on 11 September and the bonds are scheduled for issue on 15 September. Eligible applicants must hold a valid Hong Kong identity card and have been born on or before 31 December 1967.

zh.headline: 銀債認購創紀錄 47.8萬人申請近1200億元
zh.dek: 最新一批三年期銀債保底息4.25厘，合資格60歲或以上市民反應踴躍；預計最終發行額將達上限550億元。
body: 政府最新一批銀色債券周五截止認購，初步結果顯示共有約47.8萬人申請，總金額約1197.7億元，人數及金額均創歷來新高。
該批三年期債券保底息率為4.25厘。政府發言人表示，鑑於反應熱烈，預計最終發行額會由原本目標500億元提高至上限550億元。
認購及分配結果將於9月11日公布，債券預計9月15日發行。合資格申請人須持有效香港身份證，並於1967年12月31日或之前出生。
